title: GA SR391: Senate Study Committee on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Currency; create

obligations: The committee shall undertake a study of the conditions, needs, issues, and problems mentioned above or related thereto and recommend any action or legislation which the committee deems necessary or appropriate (paragraph 3).
The chairperson shall call all meetings of the committee (paragraph 4).

The committee may conduct such meetings at such places and at such times as it may deem necessary or convenient to enable it to exercise fully and effectively its powers, perform its duties, and accomplish the objectives and purposes of this resolution (paragraph 4).

If the committee adopts any specific findings or recommendations that include suggestions for proposed legislation, the chairperson shall file a report of the same prior to the date of abolishment specified in this resolution, subject to subparagraph (C) of this paragraph (paragraph 6(A)).
If the committee adopts a report that does not include suggestions for proposed legislation, the chairperson shall file the report, subject to subparagraph (C) of this paragraph (paragraph 6(B)).

No report shall be filed unless the same has been approved prior to the date of abolishment specified in this resolution by majority vote of a quorum of the committee; a report so approved shall be signed by the chairperson of the committee and filed with the Secretary of the Senate (paragraph 6(C)).
In the absence of an approved report, the chairperson may file with the Secretary of the Senate a copy of the minutes of the meetings of the committee in lieu thereof (paragraph 6(D)).
prohibitions: No report shall be filed unless the same has been approved prior to the date of abolishment specified in this resolution by majority vote of a quorum of the committee (paragraph 6(C)).
The allowances authorized by this resolution shall not be received by any member of the committee for more than four days unless additional days are authorized (paragraph 5(D)).

Passed 2025-04-02. Reading generated by ollama:deepseek-v4-pro from the enrolled text; the full text is at the foot of this page so every statement can be checked against it. LegiScan record · official text

What it does

Creates the Senate Study Committee on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Currency to study conditions, needs, issues, and problems related to AI and digital currency and to recommend any action or legislation the committee deems necessary or appropriate (paragraphs 1 and 3).

Who it applies to

  • Senate Study Committee on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Currency (paragraph 1)
  • President of the Senate (paragraph 2)
  • chairperson of the committee (paragraph 2)
  • members of the committee (paragraph 2)

Effective date

not stated in the text

Key definitions

  • artificial intelligence (AI): the development of computer systems to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning and decision making (preamble)

Obligations

  • The committee shall undertake a study of the conditions, needs, issues, and problems mentioned above or related thereto and recommend any action or legislation which the committee deems necessary or appropriate (paragraph 3).
  • The chairperson shall call all meetings of the committee (paragraph 4).
  • The committee may conduct such meetings at such places and at such times as it may deem necessary or convenient to enable it to exercise fully and effectively its powers, perform its duties, and accomplish the objectives and purposes of this resolution (paragraph 4).
  • If the committee adopts any specific findings or recommendations that include suggestions for proposed legislation, the chairperson shall file a report of the same prior to the date of abolishment specified in this resolution, subject to subparagraph (C) of this paragraph (paragraph 6(A)).
  • If the committee adopts a report that does not include suggestions for proposed legislation, the chairperson shall file the report, subject to subparagraph (C) of this paragraph (paragraph 6(B)).
  • No report shall be filed unless the same has been approved prior to the date of abolishment specified in this resolution by majority vote of a quorum of the committee; a report so approved shall be signed by the chairperson of the committee and filed with the Secretary of the Senate (paragraph 6(C)).
  • In the absence of an approved report, the chairperson may file with the Secretary of the Senate a copy of the minutes of the meetings of the committee in lieu thereof (paragraph 6(D)).

Prohibitions

  • No report shall be filed unless the same has been approved prior to the date of abolishment specified in this resolution by majority vote of a quorum of the committee (paragraph 6(C)).
  • The allowances authorized by this resolution shall not be received by any member of the committee for more than four days unless additional days are authorized (paragraph 5(D)).

Penalties and enforcement

No penalties, enforcement mechanism, or private right of action are stated in the text (paragraphs 1-7).

How it affects AI deployment

  • The resolution does not impose any requirements, prohibitions, or compliance obligations on organisations deploying AI; it only creates a study committee to examine AI and digital currency and recommend legislation (paragraphs 1 and 3).
  • Any future legislation recommended by the committee could affect AI deployment, but the resolution itself has no direct regulatory effect (paragraph 3).

Notable exemptions

  • No exemptions are stated in the text (paragraphs 1-7).

Compliance steps

  • No compliance steps are required of organisations deploying AI because the resolution imposes no obligations on them (paragraphs 1-7).
  • For the committee itself, the steps would be: appoint six members by the President of the Senate and designate a chairperson (paragraph 2); call and conduct meetings (paragraph 4); undertake the study and recommend action or legislation (paragraph 3); adopt and file any report as required (paragraph 6); and stand abolished on December 1, 2025 (paragraph 7).

 ADOPTED SENATE


 A RESOLUTION


 1 Creating the Senate Study Committee on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Currency; and
 2 for other purposes.


 3 WHEREAS, artificial intelligence (AI), the development of computer systems to perform
 4 tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning and decision making, has
 5 the potential to spur innovation and transform industry and government; and


 6 WHEREAS, as the science and technology of AI continue to develop, more products and
 7 services are utilizing AI in fields such as healthcare, financial services, education, housing,
 8 and transportation; and


 9 WHEREAS, Georgia and other states are considering a myriad of legislation and rules to
10 protect their citizens and businesses while embracing new technology and the opportunity
11 to improve lives; and


12 WHEREAS, the emergence and rapid adoption of digital and cryptocurrency has grown
13 tremendously; and
